a.lede: AI companies are able to improve their models by submitting users' conversations as training data. Opting out is easy, you just need to know where to look.
a.title: How to stop AI companies from training on your data

b.lede: A draft UK government list of AI best practices has reminded people they don't need to thank their chatbot for its work in an attempt to use it more efficiently.
b.title: UK government tells staff to stop thanking AI chatbots
